note: Good morning twin ☀️ Monday is here and so is your water bottle, fill it up before school. Halloween is Friday, so this week we're training those teeth for the candy boss fight 🎃🦷

meals: Plain Greek yogurt with blueberries, sliced banana and crushed almonds, a glass of milk
Thai khao man gai (Hainanese chicken rice) with cucumber slices and clear soup. A few pieces of fresh pineapple right after
Salted edamame and a cheese stick, water
Grilled ribeye steak, buttery corn on the cob and steamed green beans. Finish with a cube of cheddar
days.tip: Pineapple is a bit acidic, so drink water after lunch and wait 30 minutes before your after-lunch brush.

meals: Japanese tamagoyaki (sweet-less rolled omelette), small bowl of rice, miso soup
Carrot and cucumber sticks with tzatziki
Creamy mac and cheese with broccoli bits and grilled chicken strips
Plain yogurt cup with a few raspberries stirred in
Pan-seared salmon with garlic butter, jasmine rice and sautéed bok choy. Two squares of dark chocolate right after
days.tip: Chew your veggie sticks slowly. All that crunching makes extra spit, and spit is your teeth's free repair service.

meals: Avocado toast on whole grain bread with a poached egg and a glass of milk
Thai pad kra pao with minced pork (ask for less sugar), fried egg on top, cucumber on the side
Celery with no-sugar peanut butter, water
Homemade shrimp and veggie tempura with udon soup. Small scoop of matcha ice cream right after
days.tip: Halloween prep: when you get candy Friday, pick chocolate over gummies and sour stuff, and eat it right after dinner.
